name: pocket-rocket-flight-lab
description: A flight simulator for hobby and high-power rockets that runs on a phone.
author: Dustin Lee

scripts.lint: eslint src/js build.js tests tools validation && node tools/unused-exports.js && node tools/check-module-tops.js && node tools/relink.js --check
scripts.test: node build.js && node tests/golden.js check tests/golden-snapshot.json --no-fixtures
scripts.test:record: node build.js && node tests/golden.js record tests/golden-snapshot.json --no-fixtures
